description: This file contains helper functions and declarations for ASN.1 RRC configuration related to 3GPP specifications, including functions to create ASN.1 structures from various configurations and to compute configuration differences.

methods.name: get_asn1_scs
methods.description: Converts a subcarrier_spacing enum to ASN.1 subcarrier_spacing_e.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_coreset
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 coreset_s structure from configuration.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_search_space
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 search_space_s structure from configuration.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_scs_specific_carrier_list
methods.description: Generates a list of ASN.1 scs_specific_carrier_s from a list.

methods.name: make_asn1_init_dl_bwp
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 bwp_dl_common_s structure for downlink BWP.

methods.name: make_asn1_rrc_initial_up_bwp
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 bwp_ul_common_s structure for uplink BWP.

methods.name: calculate_cell_group_config_diff
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 cell_group_cfg_s struct based on previous and next UE configurations.

methods.name: calculate_reconfig_with_sync_diff
methods.description: Computes ReconfigurationWithSync ASN.1 structure during handover.

methods.name: calculate_meas_gap_config_diff
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 meas_gap_cfg_s based on UE configuration changes.
